Problem Statement:
Given a range of 2 numbers (i.e) L and R count the number of prime numbers in the range (inclusive of L and R ).
Input Description:
Input Size : L <= R <= 100000 (complexity O(n) read about Sieve of Eratosthenes)
Sample Input:
2 5
Sample Output:
3
